svg.title: Event-driven handoff between two eight-neuron layers sharing two physical neuron circuits
svg.desc: Five Layer-1 neurons connect to eight logical Layer-2 neurons and then to eight logical Layer-3 neurons. Layers 2 and 3 share one core containing two physical neuron circuits. A red neuron with a white separator and red outer ring marks the currently firing Layer-1 source and the firing Layer-2 neuron. Layer-2 neurons are processed in pairs. When one Layer-2 neuron fires, Layer 2 pauses and the same two circuits process all eight Layer-3 neurons in four pairs before Layer-2 processing resumes. A red line marks a pending or emitted spike without placing a stationary packet dot on the synapse. After its target is processed, the red overlay disappears and the synapse returns to the same pale-blue style as every other inactive synapse. Only one Layer-2 neuron fires during the representative cycle.
svg.text: Event-driven handoff on a shared time-multiplexed core
one shared core · P = 2 physical neuron circuits
Layer 2 paused · same circuits processing Layer 3
